verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent is a programmatic WebSocket API whose agent configurations can be created and persisted through the API, so it can be driven without a UI. The official dg CLI also runs Deepgram operations from the terminal, though its documented functions (transcription, streaming, TTS, account management) are not explicitly agent-specific. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless automation documentation, non-interactive auth guidance for CI (e.g., env-var API keys), CLI coverage of Voice Agent operations, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You open one WebSocket connection, send audio in, and receive audio out.
The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
Store a reusable agent block using the Console API and receive a unique UUID... Reference that UUID in your Settings message instead of repeating the full configuration.
